shortDescription: Valentin Vacherot’s win probability in the Polymarket submarket for the US Open ATP match against Kamil Majchrzak jumped sharply from 54.5% one hour ago to 75.5%, a 21% swing. According to ChainCatcher, the move was tracked by Catcher Predict monitoring and may reflect the impact of breaking news.
